recorded_preference_geometry.scope: Exact lower-loss preferences on the common completed observed physical pool, separately by world seed. Missing or technically failed rows are retained but excluded from this descriptive geometry. Ties use literal recorded values; no tolerance, imputation, new preference or adoption veto is introduced. An observed minimum is not a global optimum; pair counts are not independent replications.

scope: Every accepted decision occurrence, including repeated paper/content records, contributes once. Signs use the fixed three-position mean minus the declared center3. Rational components explain arithmetic; literal floating-point losses alone determine the reported observed preferences, and no original loss or selection is recomputed in a different numeric representation. Rejected or unproduced content is not rerated. These realized accepted sets and opinions are not causal mediation, attainable subset optima, verified science, independent critic errors or independent optimizer histories.
